items.html: And behold, in the world of Beriah, a blemish was added in the holiness of Beriah, in AA and Aba, and a correction in the Klipa of AA and Aba. For also Aba of holiness of Beriah was darkened and does not illuminate, only the light of Ima alone. And this is the secret of what is said in the Tikkunim: 'the upper Ima nests in the three Sefirot of the Throne.' For in AA and Aba 'He made darkness His hiding-place.' And opposite this, a correction was added in the Klipa of Beriah, also in their Aba and Ima, and light was drawn to them from the Aba and Ima of holiness, as will be explained with God's help.
